caption:
Your Google Business Profile has a chat button.

Most owners never open its settings.

Google requires a reply within 24 hours or it can shut the feature off entirely. Your average response time also shows up publicly on your listing, before a lead ever calls you.

The 5-minute fix:

1. Open your Business Profile, go to Messages, then Chat settings
2. Turn on a welcome message
3. Write one line that confirms receipt, states your reply time, and asks a question that moves things forward: "Thanks for reaching out. We usually reply within the hour. What's your zip code and what's going on?"
4. Set an away message too, so nights and weekends get covered

A good welcome message holds the lead while you get to your phone.

Set it once and it works every time.

rationale: Quick-tutorial to-camera reels win completion and saves right now, and GBP chat's 24-hour deactivation deadline ties straight to the brand's speed-to-lead thesis: Google expects a reply to messages within 24 hours and can deactivate messaging for profiles that repeatedly leave chats unanswered.
